newsitem.title: USA: Most U.S. debt futures erase gains to end lower.
newsitem.headline: Most U.S. debt futures erase gains to end lower.

text.p: Sept 27 - Most U.S. debt futures ended lower, erasing the day's gains as end-of-quarter buying dried up. Traders took profits once Dec T-bonds fell below Thursday's high of 109-31/32. Traders were also cautious ahead of next week's U.S. economic reports, including labor on Friday. Dec fell to 109-12/32, near support at 109-10/32. -Derivatives Desk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
